product.title: APPLIED NUTRITION Multi-Vitamin Complex
product.body_html:
Applied Nutrition Multi-Vitamin Complex

A comprehensive daily multi-vitamin tablet built with 30+ vitamins, minerals, probiotics, and antioxidants — designed for active adults, lifters, athletes, busy professionals, and anyone whose daily diet isn't quite filling every micronutrient gap. Particularly suited to those running heavy training programmes where micronutrient demands are elevated, anyone whose food intake varies day-to-day (travel, shift work, busy schedules), and people who want a serious clinical-dose multivitamin rather than the underdosed supermarket pills that crowd the shelves.

What separates Applied Nutrition Multi-Vitamin Complex from the typical multivitamin on the market comes down to formulation depth, bioavailability, and dose strength. Most cheap commodity multivitamins use the lowest-cost vitamin and mineral forms, which often have poor absorption — the actual usable dose delivered to your cells is far below what the label suggests. Multi-Vitamin Complex uses the most bioavailable sources of each ingredient at leading dosages, meaning what's on the label is closer to what actually gets absorbed and used. The formula stacks over 30 ingredients across four categories: vitamins (the full A through K spectrum), minerals (including zinc, magnesium, selenium, and other essential micronutrients), probiotics (for gut health and immune support), and antioxidants (for cellular protection against training-induced oxidative stress). For active adults specifically, the formula contributes to normal immune function during and after intense physical exercise, normal nervous system function, normal muscle and cognitive function, and normal connective tissue formation — covering essentially every major physiological pathway impacted by serious training. The 3-times-daily dosing protocol is meaningful: many vitamins and minerals are water-soluble and absorbed in limited amounts per dose, so splitting intake across the day delivers higher total daily absorption than a single dose.

Applied Nutrition manufactures Multi-Vitamin Complex in the UK in facilities certified to GMP standards, with rigorous quality control across the range. Every batch is tested for banned substances under a monitored programme at an ISO 17025 accredited lab. The product is Halal certified. Note: this specific product is not Informed-Sport certified — competing tested-pool athletes should always check the most current ingredient panel against their governing body's banned-substance list before use; for everyone else, Applied Nutrition's manufacturing pedigree as a leading UK sports nutrition brand makes this one of the more credible options in the daily multivitamin category.

  • 30+ vitamins, minerals, probiotics, and antioxidants in a single daily complex — far more comprehensive than basic multivitamins
  • Most bioavailable ingredient sources — what's on the label is closer to what actually gets absorbed
  • Leading dosages of every ingredient — clinical-grade dosing, not token amounts
  • Supports immune function during intense exercise, muscle function, and connective tissue — particularly relevant for active adults
  • 90 tablets per pack, halal certified, batch-tested for athletes — a serious upgrade over commodity multivitamin pills, strong value at the multivitamin price in Sri Lanka category

Pair it with a daily omega-3 or magnesium supplement from our vitamins and supplements range to round out a complete daily wellness routine.
